note.text: Relying on a single outside provider for core AI capability is a strategic decision, even when it looks like the default. Organizations that build or fine-tune their own models gain something harder to price than performance: control over cost, data, and direction when the market shifts. Sovereignty here does not mean building everything from scratch, it means knowing which capabilities are too important to rent. That choice, made early, is what separates companies steering their own AI roadmap from those simply following someone else's.
